items.title: Tyson Foods (TSN) Stock Could Be 35% Undervalued After Profit Forecast Cut
items.summary: Tyson Foods stock has returned 14.2% over the past year, and an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach currently points to the shares trading at a 35.1% discount to that estimate, even though the broader valuation checks lean cautious. The 14.2% one year return suggests Tyson Foods has already rewarded patient shareholders, so any perceived discount now matters more for new capital going into the stock.
